data.title: Operating and heating cost statement 2025 – €184.30 to pay
data.summary: Wohnbau Musterstadt eG sent the operating and heating cost statement for 2025 (your period of use 1 October–31 December 2025). Your costs are €544.30 against prepayments of €360.00, so you owe €184.30 by 9 October 2026. Monthly prepayments rise from 1 November 2026.
data.explanation: Your landlord has settled the service charges (Betriebs- und Heizkosten) for the three months you lived there in 2025. Your prepayments did not cover the costs, so you owe an additional €184.30, due by 9 October 2026. From 1 November 2026 your monthly prepayments go up by €30, so your total rent becomes €670.00. If you pay by direct debit this happens automatically; otherwise update your standing order. You may raise objections (Einwendungen) within twelve months after receiving the statement, and you can inspect the receipts by appointment. Consider checking the figures, and get advice from a tenants' association if something looks wrong.
data.tax_note: Service charges may include labour costs for household-related services (e.g. cleaning, garden, caretaker) that can be claimed in a tax return; check the statement.
